profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Adobe | Building agentic AI for the SDLC

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Designing and shipping multi-agent orchestration systems that take real engineering work from natural-language intent to merged code.

- Integrating agentic workflows into existing developer tooling, including Slack, GitHub, and Jira, to meet engineers where they already work.

- Building automated code review capabilities that leave inline feedback on pull requests, extending what AI agents can reliably contribute to a production codebase.

- Contributing to agentic engineering strategy and architecture across Adobe's Marketing & Web Platform team within M@S Studio.
positions.insights: Skills: Agentic AI Development · Software Infrastructure · Software Development · Agentic Automation · Software Design

positions.title: iOS / Android / Web Developer
positions.description:
- Drove the native iOS rebuild (Swift/Objective-C) of legacy hybrid apps (Cordova/Ionic), improving performance, reliability, and accessibility compliance.

- Built and maintained push notifications infrastructure and payment processing flows, including Apple Pay and mobile wallet integrations.

- Led and mentored a team of mobile developers, setting technical direction, reviewing architecture, and raising the bar on code quality and accessibility standards.

- Partnered with product, design, and security teams to ship features used by millions of banking customers daily.

positions.title: iOS / Android / Web Developer
positions.description: Built and maintained native iOS, Android, and web applications for client projects across multiple industries.

projects.title: ARQROO
projects.description: Arqroo is a bimonthly magazine of architecture, art and design located in the city of Cozumel, MX. Its main objective is the dissemination of contemporary architectural culture of the region. This is a Universal application and its used to sell their digital magazine trough the App Store. Available for iPhone and iPad

projects.title: Grades Unlimited
projects.description: Grades Unlimited it’s an online educational service that offers innovative teaching techniques across a vast spectra of academic topics. The iPhone app was made in order to let students obtain information about their schedules and to allow parents to subscribe their children and pay their classes.
